heading.opened.title: Lot 1187
text: The Stellar Institute is selling its old archive to pay for a new roof. Lot 1187, in the auction room off the needle office at {place}: 'Course home, Scholz's Star. Filed forty years ago. Unread.'

{ancient_scholar} has bid on nothing all morning. She raises her card for 1187, and so does a clerk in House Rostrom's grey. 'It isn't a course home,' she says to nobody in particular. 'It's a course to home. There is a difference.'

{ancient_scholar} sees you in the doorway and lowers her card. 'You filed it,' she says. 'You should be the one to open it.' The clerk in House Rostrom's grey does not lower his.

The Rostrom clerk recognises you and goes pale. House Rostrom was founded on your loan, and he has orders to let you outbid him, once.

choices.say: Let House Rostrom have it, and ask to read it

heading.read.title: The heading
text: You read it in the auction room, standing up.
The course runs from Scholz's Star back towards Sol and ends past Sedna's orbit, at a field the old charts call the Stator Field. It is not a way to the builders' home. The builders were us.
{ancient_scholar.short} reads it aloud in the auction room, slowly, so the Rostrom clerk hears every word.
The course runs from Scholz's Star back towards Sol and ends past Sedna's orbit, at a field the old charts call the Stator Field. It is not a way to the builders' home. The builders were us.
'Forty years,' she says. 'Somebody file that this time.'
The Rostrom clerk lets you read it over his shoulder before he seals it for {ysolde}.

ring.expedition.title: The Stator Field
text: The course from the heading ends past Sedna's orbit, where Sol's old charts mark the Stator Field. House Rostrom fits out an expedition: a Hansa lead hauler, a Mandate escort, and room for haulers who will carry the instruments.
What they find is forty kilometres of grey alloy, curved, turning once every eleven minutes: a segment of a ring around the Sun.

What they find is forty kilometres of grey alloy, curved, turning once every eleven minutes: a segment of a ring around the Sun.
Your name is on the file they are following. House Rostrom offers a finder's fee, if you would rather stay home.

choices.say: Sign on with House Rostrom's survey
Take the finder's fee (25,000) and stay home

ring.segment.title: Forty kilometres of grey
text: Up close the segment is quieter than a dock. Every eleven minutes it turns a hand's width, and every clock on your ship loses a second it never gets back.
House Rostrom's survey boats hang off its inner face like gnats. Nobody has touched it. Everybody wants to be first.

choices.say: Put a glove on the hull

ring.lost.title: Eleven years early
text: The needle ahead of yours forms up at the edge of the Stator Field, jumps, and does not arrive. The segment turned under it, once, and went dark.

Three days later the Hansa finds that needle's asteroid in the harbour at Barnard's Star, logged as arriving eleven years ago. Its crews have waited eleven years for today. Some of them are on the dock, old, watching your needle come in.
The segment is quiet now, and the Mandate has closed Sol's outer system. Everybody wants the logs from your needle: the last to see it turn.

choices.say: Give the logs to the Hansa
Give the logs to the Mandate
Give the logs to House Rostrom
